template.name: Furatena Docs Platform
template.description: A production-shaped proprietary documentation platform with public-Git content, search, graph APIs, agent artifacts, atomic refresh, and rollback.

variables.name: FURA_CONTENT_REPOSITORY
variables.description: Public HTTPS Git repository containing the docs app

variables.name: FURA_CONTENT_REF
variables.description: Git branch, tag, or exact commit allowed by the content policy; defaults to main

variables.name: FURA_CONTENT_SUBDIRECTORY
variables.description: Repository-relative directory containing docs.yaml; defaults to app

variables.name: FURA_CONTENT_ALLOWED_HOSTS
variables.description: Comma-separated allowlist for credential-free content repository hosts

variables.name: FURA_CONTENT_STATE_ROOT
variables.description: Persistent volume root for content generations, receipts, and last-known-good state

variables.name: RAILWAY_RUN_UID
variables.description: Start only the volume ownership bootstrap as root; Furatena immediately drops to uid/gid 65532

variables.name: FURA_CONTENT_REFRESH_TOKEN
variables.description: Generated bearer used only for content refresh and rollback requests

variables.name: FURA_SESSION_SECRET
variables.description: Generated secret for runtime session integrity

variables.name: FURA_BASE_URL
variables.description: Canonical public HTTPS origin derived from the Railway service or customer domain

variables.name: FURA_IMAGE_VERSION
variables.description: Promoted runtime release version supplied with the private image

variables.name: FURA_IMAGE_CHANNEL
variables.description: Promoted runtime release channel; production deployments use stable

variables.name: FURA_IMAGE_DIGEST
variables.description: Exact promoted sha256 image digest used for runtime identity and rollback

variables.name: FURA_ENV
variables.description: Runtime environment profile; the official template defaults to production

variables.name: FURA_STRUCTURED_LOGS
variables.description: Emit structured operational logs for Railway log collection when set to 1

publication_gates: stable image record exists for the exact source digest
SSH and image source editing are disabled by Railway
support, update, rollback, revocation, and licensing terms are published
